dedupe_keys.name: info trafic sur les routes departementales de loire atlantique temps reel

description: Info trafic sur les routes départementales de Loire-Atlantique (temps réel) is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Ce service retourne les informations routières sur le réseau des routes départementales, dont les chantiers, les accidents en cours, les déviations,... Ce sont les informations diffusées sur les panneaux d'informations routiers. Voir aussi: Alertes mobilité en Loire-Atlantique (temps réel). Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Mobilité. The portal shows 62 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
